document_name: Speed WMS Data Model — General Rules

extensions._SYS: System info — internal to Speed WMS

rules.primary_key: Every table always has a XXX_KEYU unique key
rules.access_pattern: All DB access uses the pair: ACT_CODE (Activity) + the entity code (e.g. ART_CODE, OPE_NOOE)
rules.field_names: Fields always have the same name regardless of the table
exceptions: SEX_DAT uses SEX_ACT instead of ACT_CODE
OPL_DAT and OPE_DAT share OPE_KEYU as alternate join key
MIL_DAT and MIE_DAT share MIE_KEYU as alternate join key
Loadings join conditions depend on client configuration
Packaging join conditions depend on client configuration

configurable_fields.description: Present in all tables. Labels configured per activity.

complementary.XXX_ALPHA1_to_10: VARCHAR(50) — up to 10 additional text fields per table
complementary.XXX_NUM1_to_5: Float/Real — up to 5 numeric fields per table
complementary.XXX_TOP1_to_5: Boolean — up to 5 boolean flags per table
complementary.XXX_DATE1_to_5: Date — up to 5 date fields per table
complementary.XXX_HEURE1_to_5: Time HHMMSS — up to 5 time fields per table

supplementary.description: Environment-specific fields. May have validation rules applied.

_SYS.notes: Managed internally by Speed WMS — do not modify directly

_PAR.notes: Configuration and reference data, typically static

_DAT.notes: Live operational data — most frequently queried

safety_rules: Always include ACT_CODE in every query — it partitions all data by activity/warehouse
Never query _SYS tables directly in production SQL without Speed WMS approval
Every table has a XXX_KEYU surrogate key — prefer joining on business keys (ACT_CODE + entity code) not KEYU for cross-table joins
SEX_DAT is the only table that breaks the ACT_CODE convention — it uses SEX_ACT instead
